title: Saturday at Gravity Grove
question: Which attraction is the real bottleneck, and where should we add capacity or change prices?

nodes.name: Thunder Spine
nodes.about: The famous launch coaster, viral on TikTok; notoriously long lines

nodes.name: Vortex Drop
nodes.about: Terrifying-looking drop tower; the line moves fast

nodes.name: Galaxy Simulator
nodes.about: Indoor motion simulator; air-conditioned, a little dated

nodes.name: Haunted Manor
nodes.about: Dark ride; little kids often come out crying

nodes.name: River Rapids
nodes.about: You will get soaked; popular on hot afternoons

nodes.name: Sky Wheel
nodes.about: Slow giant wheel with the best view; couples love it

nodes.name: Bumper Arena
nodes.about: Bumper cars; quick, loud, kids beg for it

nodes.name: Starlight Carousel
nodes.about: Gentle carousel for little kids; almost never a line

nodes.name: Food Court
nodes.about: Big indoor food hall with AC and seats; pricey

nodes.name: Churro Cart
nodes.about: Famous churros from one tiny window

archetypes.name: Thrill seekers
archetypes.description: Teens and young adults chasing the biggest rides.

archetypes.name: Families
archetypes.description: Parents with kids; short patience, hungry often.

archetypes.name: Casual visitors
archetypes.description: Pass holders and couples who wander and snack.

minds.name: Jaylen Brooks
minds.bio: Here with three friends from school on a season pass; has ridden Thunder Spine 40 times.
minds.personality: competitive, impatient, lives for the group chat
minds.goal: Ride Thunder Spine and Vortex Drop as many times as possible
minds.social: goes wherever his three friends vote to go

minds.name: Sofia Marín
minds.bio: College student on her first visit with her boyfriend; saw Thunder Spine on TikTok.
minds.goal: Get the Thunder Spine video for her followers
minds.social: boyfriend hates long lines and complains

minds.name: Dev Patel
minds.bio: Software engineer who came alone to ride everything efficiently.
minds.personality: analytical, hates wasted time, optimizes everything
minds.social: alone; reads other guests' posts about lines

minds.name: Marcus Reed
minds.bio: Coaster enthusiast who reviews rides on his blog.
minds.personality: stubborn, purist, scornful of kiddie rides
minds.goal: Ride Thunder Spine in the front row, whatever the wait
minds.social: alone; ignores what other people say

minds.name: Linh Nguyen
minds.bio: Mom with kids aged 6 and 9 plus a grandmother who needs to sit often.
minds.goal: Keep everyone happy until the fireworks with no meltdowns
minds.social: grandmother gets tired; kids want whatever looks exciting

minds.name: Tom Fischer
minds.bio: Dad with a 4-year-old who is terrified of dark rides.
minds.personality: patient but wears down fast, listens to other parents
minds.goal: Carousel, something with water, and a nap-free afternoon
minds.social: takes advice from parents he overhears in line

minds.name: Aisha Bello
minds.bio: Single mom with 7-year-old twins, tight budget, packed lunch in a cooler.
minds.goal: A full day of free rides without buying food
minds.social: twins argue and she splits the difference

minds.name: Helen Kowalski
minds.bio: Grandmother taking her grandson to the park for his 10th birthday.
minds.personality: gentle, slow walker, cannot stand for long
minds.goal: Make the birthday special without standing in long lines
minds.social: grandson wants Thunder Spine but is barely tall enough

minds.name: Carlos Ruiz
minds.bio: Father of three teenagers who split up and regroup at the Food Court.
minds.personality: easygoing, glued to the park app
minds.goal: Everyone back at the Food Court for lunch and dinner
minds.social: teens text him which lines are short

minds.name: Rosa Delgado
minds.bio: Teacher chaperoning eight fifth-graders on a school trip.
minds.goal: Keep all eight kids in sight and on schedule
minds.social: kids beg to go wherever the crowd is

minds.name: Emma Clarke
minds.bio: Annual pass holder who comes for the atmosphere and the churros.
minds.goal: Churros, a calm ride, and no line over 15 minutes
minds.social: follows a park fan group that posts live tips

minds.name: Walter Hughes
minds.bio: Retired, walks the park with his wife twice a month.
minds.goal: Sky Wheel and a sit-down lunch

minds.name: Priya Shah
minds.personality: image-driven, chatty, chases whatever has buzz
minds.goal: Film where the crowd and the hype are
minds.social: posts constantly; her followers reply with tips

minds.name: Ben Okoro
minds.bio: On a date with his girlfriend, trying to make it romantic.
minds.goal: Sky Wheel at sunset and a nice dinner
minds.social: girlfriend wants at least one big ride
